t_advice_summary_textbox.text: First the yellow basket gave more mushrooms then something about red mushrooms. I will start to see patterns and learn what mushroom characters give the yellow basket for more points. Gnome with the flat orange hat gives yellow baskets and the one with flat red hat gives red baskets. If you dont get points just go for the opposite choice.
